note: Placed structures (Dave 2026-10-20: lean-to and storage chest are the first buildables). Placed like the campfire kit with ACT_PLACE (count = yaw in degrees). state is the world-item row state clients draw it by (5 lean-to, 6 chest). cap_per_chunk counts one 256 m chunk. A lean-to is a roof for the Cover index: a box of half_x by half_z around its spot, from 0.5 m below the ground to height above it. A structure with slots is a container: its contents are server-owned (chests.json) and sent only to the player who opens it.
